paras: Application: Ford Focus ST 2015-2018 (2.0L EcoBoost) Part Type: Dual (PCV + CCV) catch can kit Part Number: 20-0358-FL

A catch can separates oil and water condensation from crankcase gases before they reach the intake, preventing oil build-up on the intake, intercooler walls, throttle body and intake manifold. Cleaner intake air helps effective octane and performance, and the closed system keeps oil vapour out of the cabin.
hl: Dual Protection: PCV can on the front LH core support plus CCV can at the back LH side of the engine bay
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet ports with a 4AN ORB drain port
Easy Checking: O-ring sealed dipstick shows how much fluid has been collected
